title: Maximum Number That Makes Result of Bitwise AND Zero
description: Given an integer `n`, return the **maximum** integer `x` such that `x <= n`, and the bitwise `AND` of all the numbers in the range `[x, n]` is 0.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Maximum Number That Makes Result of Bitwise AND Zero.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
